notes.title: Metaneurosis Roadmap + Demo Changes!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I wanted to share a quick update on where things are headed. I’ve put together a visual [b]roadmap[/b] outlining what’s coming next for [i]Metaneurosis[/i], from new world content to upcoming polish and side quests.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/c29ced27396d0aa96c02a550ba4d374bf1866e56.png"][/img][/p][p]Demo Update:[/p][p]The demo has been updated to include all the new changes made to the game's mechanics. It now has all the same features and QoL improvements as the main game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank You:[/b][/p][p]Seriously, thanks so much to everyone who has played, left feedback, or even just wishlisted the game. This project means a lot to me, and your support is what helps keep it moving forward.[/p][p]As always, feel free to drop thoughts, theories, or just weird observations in the discussions — especially with how much bizarre stuff there is in this game.[/p][p]More soon![/p][p]— Lazy Dev Studio[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473911/8a60dd21ff0280a94754a8fcf41014bab519dc51.gif"][/img][/p]
